{{Quote|What about dinner? You were supposed to get something to eat.''"<br />"''I did. The Kagles just made me tobo leaves, jing-jang berries, fried mahuga.|Wicket Warrick and Teebo|<ref name="Ewoks" />}}
'''Tobo leaves''' were a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] [[Diet/Legends|edible]] by the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Ewoks" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="EwoksDate">{{EwoksDate|mention of tobo leaves|[[Home Is Where the Shrieks Are]]}}</ref> a trio of the [[Color/Legends|brown]]-[[Hair/Legends|furred]] individuals known as the [[Kagles]] made and served tobo leaves, along with [[fried mahuga]] and [[Jinjang berry|jing-jang berries]], to the Ewok [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] while on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. Teebo later recounted the dinner's dishes to his friend, [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Warrick]].<ref name="Ewoks" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:KaglesFood.png|thumb|right|200px|Teebo holds a type of food.]]
Tobo leaves were mentioned in "[[Home Is Where the Shrieks Are]],"<ref name="Ewoks" /> the third episode in the [[Ewoks: Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']]. The episode was written by [[Bob Carrau]], and it premiered on [[September 20]], [[1986]].<ref name="Insider 27">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref> In the episode, after Teebo tells Wicket of three foods that the Kagles fed him, he holds up a small, orange sphere, indicating that that was all he had left from dinner. As the episode does not establish which of the foods the sphere is,<ref name="Ewoks" /> this article refrains from linking it with tobo leaves or any of the other foods he mentioned.
